$comment: PERMANENT abbrev registry. Abbrevs are 3-letter lowercase, collision-checked, and NEVER recycled or changed once assigned to a resource — like a stock ticker. Adding a row is allowed; changing or removing a resource's abbrev, or reusing an abbrev for a second resource, fails compile (Samen.Verifiers.AbbrevRegistry). Keys are abbrevs; values are the fully-qualified resource module names that own them.
